newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Dr Oetker to start joint venture in Bulgaria in 97.
newsitem.headline: Dr Oetker to start joint venture in Bulgaria in 97.

text.p: Germany's privately-owned food group Dr Oetker plans to begin production of desserts and baking ingredients in Bulgaria next year, a company official said on Thursday.
It said it was negotiating with several local food manufacturers on the possibility of setting up a joint venture next year.
"The strategic goal of Dr Oetker is to produce in Bulgaria the products which it now distributes here," Georgi Gramenov, executive director of Dr Oetker Bulgaria OOD, told a news conference.
The company generated turnover of 100 million marks in eastern Europe in 1995 and operates joint ventures in all other countries in the region.
Bulgaria, shaken by a grave economic crisis, has the lowest level of foreign investment in the region due to excessive red tape and inconsistently applied legislation.
